entry: entry.ts -> unchanged original main.tsx / App / MainLayout
reason: Basic real-Core paths, Role prompt/remarks/delete/restore/instance creation and batch enable/stop/restart/reset, channel metadata and personal mute/collapse are connected. DM/private/thread, remaining messages/tasks/files/memory/notification/mobile and capability omissions still require adapters and acceptance. Do not deploy this as the complete product.

exceptionOwners.policy.ts: Explicit omission of incompatible Raft Agent tabs and cloud subscription limits. No new UI dimensions or recipes.
exceptionOwners.api.ts / commands.ts / read-bridge.ts /: Loom typed SDK and canonical identity/causal/idempotency boundaries; native read caches are presentation only.
exceptionOwners.sidebar.ts: Native kind references, sparse section placement/order and file-tab DTOs map to the existing version-fenced HumanSidebar owner. Unverified legacy peer identity is unavailable, never guessed as a Role or Agent.
exceptionOwners.agent-facets.ts: Native single Agent read cache split into verified Role and Instance views; no business identity inference.
Native read cache with SDK lifecycle commands; acknowledged writes refresh observations rather than synthesizing working/offline status.
exceptionOwners.role-profile.tsx / role-instances.tsx /: Owner-approved Role/Instance semantics using original Dialog, ConfirmDialog, form fields, SectionHeader, ListRowGroup and MachineAgentRow. Prompt/remarks, stable-ID restoration, instance creation and state controls are explicit Loom-only slots, not replacement page layouts.
exceptionOwners.runtime-shared.ts / runtime-models.ts: Loom's six installed native CLI families and Host-published model choices, not Raft's hosted providers/Kimi SDK.
exceptionOwners.avatars.ts / legacy-avatar-assets.ts: Native sixteen-preset selection; existing saved newer/uploaded/history artwork remains readable without changing Role revisions.
exceptionOwners.fonts.ts: Local delivery of exactly matching native fonts; no font-size or typography substitutions.
exceptionOwners.realtime-driver.ts: Visible-view durable SDK reads with per-Room sync; no invented global message sequence, socket completion or delivery ACK.
